ModMetaData.name: Medieval Overhaul - Recycle Only 1.5 v1.4
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Adds recycling only to Medieval Overhaul's existing mending bench. Reuses MO's own mending WorkGiver, JobDriver, effects and repair-tool fuel path. Base workAmount is exactly 30 like MO mending. Actual recycle work mirrors mending in reverse: 30 work per remaining HP.
